name: HC10k: Positive for Aspergillosis
description: Number of new ART clients with baseline CD4 &amp;lt;200 tested positive for Aspergillosis - PLACEHOLDER: Requires ETL enhancement
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson:
{
  "version": 1,
  "patientIdColumn": "patient_id",
  "populationQuery": {
    "extractFrom": "sqlTemplate"
  },
  "supportsRedisaggregation": true,
  "redisaggregationStrategy": "population-extraction",
  "themeIndependent": true,
  "dataSources": [
    "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary",
    "mamba_fact_test_orders_results",
    "mamba_fact_encounter_diagnosis"
  ],
  "sqlTemplate": "SELECT DISTINCT s.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.patient_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND s.baseline_cd4 < 200
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results r
      WHERE r.patient_id = s.patient_id
        AND r.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
        AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_parameter)) = 'ASPERGILLOSIS RESULTS'
        AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_value)) = 'POSITIVE'
  );",

  );"
}
sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT s.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.patient_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND s.baseline_cd4 < 200
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results r
      WHERE r.patient_id = s.patient_id
        AND r.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
        AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_parameter)) = 'ASPERGILLOSIS RESULTS'
        AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_value)) = 'POSITIVE'
  );
